description: This file defines schema validation, migration, and version detection functions for etcd storage schema management, including version-specific changes and migration plans.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks if the provided backend schema is supported.

methods.name: unsafeValidate
methods.description: Performs unsafe validation of schema version.

methods.name: localBinaryVersion
methods.description: Returns the local binary version as a semantic version.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Updates storage schema to a target version, handling downgrades.

methods.name: UnsafeMigrate
methods.description: Performs unsafe migration of storage schema to a target version.

methods.name: DetectSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the storage schema based on backend data.

methods.name: UnsafeDetectSchemaVersion
methods.description: Unsafe version of schema version detection.

methods.name: schemaChangesForVersion
methods.description: Retrieves schema changes for a specific version.
